name: Fader chops on sixteenths
lesson:
## Twice as fast, exactly as even

Sixteenth-note chops on channel fader A for 4 bars: 64 moves at 150 ms apart. At this speed the hand cannot think about each move; it has to lock to the grid and stay there. Any flip that lands late pushes every flip after it late.

Sixteenth chops are what fill the last two bars before a drop in open-format sets. Keep the pattern for the full 4 bars here so the scorer can see whether you drift; in a set you would use it for 2 and then hit the drop.
